prompt_en: A photographic portrait of a newly authored adult woman, age 28, in a small neighborhood café at the end of a rainy evening. The subject's face and hair follow the supplied reference: a short dark brown bob with fine loose fringe, brown eyes, softly curved brows, a softly rounded cheek and jaw contour, and softly glossy pink lips. The photograph holds one independently authored moment: she has stepped from a cleared table toward the open doorway and is offering the viewer the last half of a ripe fig. Her right hand extends halfway between her chest and the lens, holding the fig by its purple skin, its cut red interior turned upward; her left hand supports a shallow white saucer at waist height. In this offer the subject attached hand extends toward the camera position; the offered object follows the visible subject hand contact. Here the offered hand or object occupies a nearer plane than the face, and the near object leaves the requested facial expression region readable: the fig remains below her chin. The two forearms stay separated against her cardigan. She stands upright on level tile. Her gaze meets the viewer directly, and a small uneven smile feels like a private invitation, with the lips gently parted. Her mouth corners turn up unequally; the cheeks lift softly, narrowing the open eyes a little as she offers the red fig toward us. She wears an oatmeal ribbed cardigan with its neckline resting naturally at the collarbones and a simple dark olive skirt. Behind her, a cleared table and two chairs stacked seat-to-seat mark the café's closing time; rain beads catch cool reflections on the glass door. A single warm wall lamp lights her cheek and the fruit from the side. At conversational distance with the camera at her eye level, a vertical knee-up frame keeps her face, both forearms, the fig, and the saucer readable. Gentle focus falloff lets her eyes lead and the fruit follow.
